name: text-editor
description: A CodeMirror-based editor tab with real TextMate/Shiki syntax highlighting (matching the active theme's own tokenColors, including VS Code-style bracket-pair depth coloring) and save-back to disk, for quick edits without a round-trip through nvim.

textEditor.extensions.description: Comma-separated file extensions (no dot) this editor opens for. Excludes json/yml/yaml, md/markdown, html/htm, and csv/tsv by default since those already have a dedicated bundled preview — add one back here if you'd rather edit it as plain text. Reached via the hover Preview icon, the "Preview" context-menu item, or Shift+Enter — unless "Open this editor on a plain FILES click" is on.

textEditor.openOnClick.description: Open this editor directly on a plain FILES-tree click instead of nvim, for the configured extensions. Takes effect after a page reload.
